bibl.title: Un fiore per Medea Norsa, da Gilda Nadia Goldschmied
bibl.seg: Anna Di Giglio & Rosario Pintaudi, Un fiore per Medea Norsa, da Gilda Nadia Goldschmied.
bibl.note: A watercolor on cardboard, depicting a rose, was found in a notebook belonged to Girolamo Vitelli and now kept in the Laurentian Library. The card is signed by Gilda Nadia and addressed to Medea Norsa.
